name: Blake Landers
source:
Blake, also known as Black, is the vocalist and guitarist of a well-known band, Cyan. 

Naturally, due to Blake's occupation, he has become the main attraction for girls within Valudeto High; however, Blake chooses to ignore most of his fans as much as possible. In fact, he ignores even his peers, making him appear almost rude, which is why Lucia doesn't necessarily get along with him.

Blake is a naive, lazy, and laid-back character who shows a lack of concern for his surroundings, and usually slacks off during class by sleeping; however, what lacks for his work ethic makes up for his strong passion and determination for music.

[spoiler]It is later revealed that Blake is an adopted child. His real father being Valudeto High's janitor, Paul, who belongs to the Rhodes family. Thus, his real name is Nathaniel Rhodes. [/spoiler]
